description: No electricity company pays ElectricityFinder (Odigital LLC, PUCT broker BR260062), so no company can pay to rank higher; it is paid only by subscribers to an optional plan on its site. This tool ranks the Texas electricity plans at a ZIP code by what each would cost over a year at the person's own monthly kWh (not the 1,000 kWh figure plan ads quote). Free, no account. Order: lowest projected yearly cost first, within the contract length in term_filter (default: the most common length); plans whose price depends on conditions (bill credits, time-of-use, usage tiers) come after plans without them. Each plan comes with its yearly cost and its Electricity Facts Label (efl_url), the provider's official sheet of rates and fees. link reopens the same comparison on electricityfinder.online, re-priced with that day's plans; it does not expire. revisit holds the link and a suggested reminder date. cheapest_any_term names a cheaper plan of another contract length when there is one. utility_note is set when a co-op or city utility serves the ZIP; homes it serves cannot choose a retail plan. A Variable or Indexed rate_type means the price can change from month to month. interval_data comes from a fixed rule and says whether 15-minute meter data could change the cheapest plan for this home. interval_data.paid_plan, present only when the verdict is interval_data_can_change_the_answer, describes the optional paid plan that prices on 15-minute data. how_to_get_my_usage explains how to get the monthly kWh numbers this tool takes.

average_monthly_kwh.description: Only when monthly numbers are not known: one typical month. Less accurate, because summer and winter differ.

term.description: Contract length to rank. default (the site's own default: the most common term, usually 12 months), 12, 24, or any (includes month-to-month plans).

usage.description: Up to 12 months of usage. Best: the last 12 months. Totals of a Smart Meter Texas 15-minute file, by month, are fine.

kwh.description: kWh used that month (from the bill or Smart Meter Texas).

zip.description: 5-digit Texas ZIP code of the home.
